build_note: Source-built from the pinned sdist: the vendored libpg_query is compiled first with clang and LLVM source coverage (bison/flex #line directives removed), then setup.py compiles the pre-generated Cython pglast/parser.c with clang -O0 and LLVM coverage and links it statically. The official wheels compile the same sources with optimisation; Cython is not run.
dependencies_note: No runtime dependencies. setuptools 84.2.1 is the build backend only. The fuzz entry point is an external one-file Python bridge, not Atheris.
parser_family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser), shared with the C libpg_query path; pglast's own Cython layer (pglast/parser.c, from parser.pyx and ast.pyx) converts the raw C parse tree into pglast.ast nodes
api: pglast.parse_sql(local SQL text decoded from UTF-8 bytes) -> tuple of pglast.ast.RawStmt nodes; the harness walks SelectStmt, InsertStmt, RangeVar, JoinExpr, FuncCall and A_Const nodes
fuzz_engine: external one-file Python bridge for AFL++ and generator replay
coverage: LLVM source-region coverage (macro expansions skipped) of the source-built pglast extension: pglast/parser.c (Cython conversion layer) and the statically linked libpg_query sources; the AFL++ bridge maps regions and branches of pglast/parser.c and the libpg_query grammar, scanner and raw_parser files
scope: One SQL statement from local text via pglast.parse_sql (PostgreSQL 18 grammar); valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. The prettifier, JSON/protobuf parse variants, PL/pgSQL parsing and the optimised wheel build are untested.
underlying_release: libpg_query 18.1.0 (vendored in the pglast sdist; PostgreSQL 18.6 raw parser, scanner and node support)
